description: User-facing pages: Landing page, Onboarding wizard, Library with PDF pipeline, and Home dashboard with daily planner. These are the entry points and first-run experience. Depends on FEAT-001 (design system, data layer, AppShell, UI components, Hoot assets).
steps: PHASE 5 — Landing page: Create src/pages/Landing.tsx assembling all landing sections. Create src/components/landing/Navbar.tsx — sticky navbar: logo (links to /), How it works / Features / Demo nav links, ThemeToggle, 'Start free' CTA button (orange gradient). Transparent → frosted-glass (backdrop-blur) on scroll (use IntersectionObserver or window scroll listener). Mobile: hamburger menu with AnimatePresence slide-down drawer. Create src/components/landing/HeroSection.tsx — full viewport, left side: 'Study smart. Score high.' headline (Plus Jakarta Sans 800) word-by-word reveal animation, subheadline, two CTAs ('Start free' → /onboarding, 'Watch demo' → sets appStore.demoMode=true then navigates to /app/home). Right side: animated mock ChatWindow — useEffect chain typewriters 'What is photosynthesis?' into the input, then streams a mock answer token by token with a 'Source: Science Ch. 6, page 42' chip appearing at the end. Orange radial glow behind the preview in dark mode (--glow-orange). Create src/components/landing/HowItWorksSection.tsx — 3 numbered steps with Framer Motion whileInView slide-up animations (once: true): (1) Upload your PDF, (2) Ask or get quizzed, (3) Track your progress. Each with an inline SVG icon and description. Create src/components/landing/FeatureGrid.tsx — 7 feature cards in responsive grid (1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 3-4 col desktop): Chat with PDFs (lucide BookOpen), Marks-card analysis (lucide BarChart3), Smart quizzes (lucide ListChecks), Voice tutor (lucide Mic), Daily study plan (lucide Calendar), Report card (lucide FileText), Works on phone (lucide Smartphone). Card hover: lift + orange glow border. Staggered entrance with Framer Motion. Create src/components/landing/MockScreenshots.tsx — 2 device mockups (CSS/SVG phone frame + browser frame) with simple sketch-style screenshots of Dashboard and Progress views. Parallax scroll. Create src/components/landing/MadeByStudents.tsx — 'Made by students, for students' section, 3 testimonial cards with student names, grades and quotes (demo data). Hoot celebrating at side. Create src/components/landing/FAQSection.tsx — Accordion with 8 questions: privacy (do files leave device?), free tier (is it free?), boards (all supported?), offline (works offline?), voice (Hindi supported?), PDF (what types?), login (need account?), data (how to export?). Animated expand/collapse (Framer Motion AnimatePresence). Create src/components/landing/Footer.tsx — Thinkr logo, tagline 'Study smart. Score high.', links, 'Built with love for Indian students'. Create src/components/landing/index.ts. ALL scroll animations: check useReducedMotion() and skip if true.

PHASE 6 — Onboarding wizard: Create src/pages/Onboarding.tsx — wizard shell with 4-dot step indicator (OnboardingProgress component), Framer Motion slide-left/right transitions between steps (AnimatePresence with custom direction). 'Back'/'Next'/'Finish' navigation. On Finish: save StudentProfile to Dexie (id=1 singleton), set appStore.language, navigate to /app/home. Create src/components/onboarding/StepName.tsx — Hoot encouraging expression, animated greeting text, name input (required, 2-40 chars), language toggle chips (English/Hindi). Create src/components/onboarding/StepBoard.tsx — Board selector: searchable, boards grouped as 'National' (CBSE, ICSE) and 'State Boards' (alphabetical) using BOARDS from src/data/boards.ts. Class selector: clickable chips 6/7/8/9/10. Both required. Create src/components/onboarding/StepSubjects.tsx — Subjects auto-populated from getSubjects(classLevel, board) (src/data/subjects.ts). Toggle chips to select/deselect. 'Select all' shortcut. Hoot thinking expression. At least 1 subject required. Create src/components/onboarding/StepMarksCard.tsx — Optional step. Dropzone for image (JPG/PNG) or PDF. If file provided: show Hoot thinking, run pdf.ts processPDF or direct Tesseract.js OCR for images, send extracted text to LLM via llm.ts buildMarksPrompt, parse JSON response, show editable MarksTable (import from progress components or create inline version). User confirms or clicks 'Skip for now'. On error: show friendly message, still allow skip. Hoot happy on success. Create src/components/onboarding/OnboardingProgress.tsx — 4 dots with orange active dot, animated scale on active state.

PHASE 7 — Library page: Create src/pages/Library.tsx — UploadDropzone at top, PDFCard grid below, empty state (Hoot encouraging, 'Upload your first PDF to get started'). Two upload buttons: 'Upload PDF' and 'Upload Marks Card' (sets type to marks_card). Create src/components/pdf/UploadDropzone.tsx — HTML5 drag-and-drop (onDragOver, onDrop, onDragLeave) + file input. Accepts .pdf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg. Privacy note: 'Your files never leave your device. Only small text snippets are sent to the AI.' in a highlighted box. On file select: triggers usePDFProcessor hook. For marks_card type: auto-navigates to marks analysis flow after processing. Max file size warning at 50MB. Create src/components/pdf/PDFCard.tsx — card with: thumbnail (base64 img or placeholder icon), file name, subject badge (Badge component), type badge, page count chip, status badge (processing=yellow, ready=green, error=red). Three-dot menu: 'Chat with PDF' (navigates to /app/tutor with doc scoped), 'Delete' (confirm Dialog then remove from Dexie). Hover lift animation. Create src/components/pdf/ProcessingProgress.tsx — progress display during PDF processing: step text ('Extracting text from page 3 of 12...'), percentage bar, Hoot thinking. Create src/components/pdf/TagSelector.tsx — appears after processing completes: subject dropdown (profile subjects), chapter text input. Subject pre-filled from filename detection if possible. Create src/hooks/usePDFProcessor.ts — manages processPDF call, tracks progress messages, writes PDFDocument + TextChunk records to Dexie, calls buildIndex from search.ts to rebuild BM25 index, handles errors. Exports: { processFile, progress, status, error }.

PHASE 12 — Home dashboard: Create src/pages/Home.tsx — single-column mobile layout, 2-column desktop. Assembles: HootGreeting, StreakCard, TodayPlanCard, QuickActions, ExamCountdown. Create src/components/home/HootGreeting.tsx — personalized greeting using profile.name. Expression by time: 5-11am happy, 11am-5pm thinking, 5-9pm encouraging, 9pm+ sleeping. 'Good morning/afternoon/evening, {name}! Ready to study?' in both English and Hindi based on appStore.language. Animated entrance. Create src/components/home/StreakCard.tsx — flame icon (animated orange gradient via CSS animation), current streak number, best streak, XP level and progress bar (XPBar component from FEAT-004). Create src/components/home/TodayPlanCard.tsx — Today's DailyPlan from Dexie. If no plan for today (checked by plan.id = ISO date string): generate via useDailyPlan hook (LLM call or rule-based fallback). Task list with checkboxes (check = update Dexie, award XP, update streak). Overall progress bar. 'All done!' Hoot celebrating when all tasks complete. Create src/components/home/QuickActions.tsx — 4 large touch-friendly buttons: 'Chat with tutor' (→ /app/tutor), 'Take a quiz' (→ /app/study), 'Review flashcards' (→ /app/study#flashcards), 'Upload PDF' (→ /app/library). Each with lucide icon and label. Create src/components/home/ExamCountdown.tsx — displays next exam from profile.examDates. Days remaining with colour: green ≥14 days, orange 7-13, red <7. 'No exams scheduled' empty state. Create src/hooks/useDailyPlan.ts — checks today's plan in Dexie, generates if missing using LLM (buildPlannerPrompt) with rule-based fallback (20 min per weak subject), handles task toggle, XP, streak. Create src/hooks/useStreak.ts — computes streak from profile.lastStudiedDate, detects gap, updates Dexie. Create src/lib/notifications.ts — requestPermission(), scheduleReminder(time, msg) using Notification API + ServiceWorker; in-app toast fallback if Notifications not supported.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build:typecheck exits with 0 TypeScript errors after all steps
npm run build completes without errors
Landing page (/) renders with all sections: Navbar, Hero, HowItWorks, FeatureGrid, MockScreenshots, MadeByStudents, FAQ, Footer
Hero animated chat preview typewriters a question and streams a mock answer with a source chip
Onboarding wizard navigates through all 4 steps, validates inputs, and saves profile to Dexie on finish
Library page shows upload dropzone, displays privacy note, and shows PDF cards after upload
Home page shows TodayPlanCard, StreakCard, HootGreeting, QuickActions
All scroll animations skip gracefully when prefers-reduced-motion is set
